item.title: You answer unknown numbers like it's the family landline.
item.description: You answer unknown numbers like it's the family landline. "Hello, this is Sam speaking." Best phone manners, every single time. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: You still cut your sandwich into triangles.
item.description: You still cut your sandwich into triangles. Squares taste different. Science can't explain it. The kitchen you grew up in can. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: You hate opening presents while everyone watches.
item.description: You hate opening presents while everyone watches. Somewhere along the way, you learned to have the perfect "oh, I love it" ready before the paper's off. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: You fold towels in thirds. Halves just look wrong.
item.description: You fold towels in thirds. Halves just look wrong. Nobody ever explained it. That's simply how towels go, in your place and in the one you grew up in. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: You still save the best bite for last. Even alone.
item.description: You still save the best bite for last. Even alone. Four small habits that started long before you could explain them. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: You read the mood of the room before you take your coat off.
item.description: You read the mood of the room before you take your coat off. You were the family weather forecaster. Some part of you still is. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: Someone says "great job." You list what went wrong.
item.description: Someone says "great job." You list what went wrong. Taking a compliment still feels like getting away with something. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: You tidy up before the cleaner comes.
item.description: You tidy up before the cleaner comes. Someone is coming to clean, so the place obviously has to look clean first. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: You finish everything on your plate. Even when you're full.
item.description: You finish everything on your plate. Even when you're full. Nobody's checking anymore. Your fork didn't get the memo. Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.

item.title: Keys in the door, and you suddenly look very busy.
item.description: Keys in the door, and you suddenly look very busy. Four small habits that started a long time ago. Which one is yours? Childhood Experiences (ACE) on MyTestPro: 29 questions.
